case.title: Feature request: Instagram booking button
case.subject: Feature idea
case.text:
Hi Slotwise,

Love the app. Would be amazing if clients could book directly from an Instagram 'Book now' button without leaving Instagram, and if you had a waitlist so clients get notified when a slot opens. Any plans for that?

Mia
case.why: Feature request: route to success, thank the customer, no roadmap promises. The booking page link can go in the Instagram bio today.

output.reply:
Hi Mia,

Thank you for the kind words and for sharing your ideas! A booking button inside Instagram and a waitlist that notifies clients when a slot opens are both useful suggestions, and I've passed them on to our team as feature requests. I don't have any information on roadmap plans or timing, so I can't promise if or when they will be available.

In the meantime, you can add your booking page link to your Instagram bio so clients can book in a couple of taps. Copy the link from Settings → Booking Page → Share. Clients will open the booking page in their browser rather than staying inside Instagram.

Best regards,
Slotwise Support
